summary: The last traces of the earlier sign-in are removed from your installation.

fixes.title: The earlier sign-in's database tables are removed
fixes.text: The database setup removes the tables the earlier sign-in front kept, and the web app's right to make tables, once the web app uses Microsoft's built-in sign-in.

fixes.title: Only Microsoft's sign-in address is kept
fixes.text: The web app's sign-in registration now needs only the address of Microsoft's built-in sign-in; the earlier address is reported as a leftover.
